outcomes_known: Primary statistics and existing functional map known; no statistical changes
alias_policy: Union of official symbol, original discovery label, description and aliases from frozen NCBI human and mouse Gene metadata. Case-insensitive duplicates removed. Broad/ambiguous aliases remain retrieval terms and require identity verification. Original committed mapping is not changed.
ambiguous_aliases: GRM2 metadata aliases GLUR2/mGluR7 may retrieve GRIA2/GRM7; those genes are excluded as different targets
Gm3604 is searched alongside ZNF28 without asserting improved orthology

pagination.rule: Retrieve all results if hitCount <=1000. If greater, retain and screen first1000 and report cap as limitation; do not claim exhaustive retrieval.

screening: Screen every retrieved title and available abstract; retain source, identifier and all target memberships through deduplication.

Follow exact-target perturbation plus possible beta-cell/islet secretion or immune-protection leads to available primary full text/supplements; acknowledge baseline observed responsiveness without requiring formal noninferiority.

Include source-resolved beta-cell/islet secreted-insulin measurements for identifiable exact-target perturbation; distinguish baseline versus immune challenge, model, editing, observed response and comparator result.
Retain protection without secretion as a separate endpoint.

Exclude association/expression/content proxies, systemic-only metabolism, nonselective pharmacology, paralog interventions and unrelated tissues as exact-target beta-cell secretion evidence; retain contextual leads and reasons.
Missing abstract/full text, ambiguous target identity or endpoint stays unresolved when information cannot resolve eligibility.
No qualifying comparison located means only within specified retrieval boundary; no biological absence or systematic-review claim.
